title: Feedback Loops
hook: Running a business with no weekly number to check is basically driving with your eyes closed.
statement: Systems run on feedback, not effort.
explainer: Effort without feedback just means going hard in whatever direction you started. A simple weekly signal tells you when to push and when to pull back.
sop: Pick one area running with no feedback at all.
Add one signal: a weekly number, a client check-in, a quick self-check.
Score your Current state and the Feedback each week.
Adjust based on the feedback, not on how you feel.
Review on a fixed schedule, not just in a crisis.
equation_example: Current state is 6. A good result gives Feedback of +2, so 6 + 2 = 8 and you push further. A bad result gives -2, so 6 - 2 = 4 and you pull back. Ignore feedback and your plan drifts away from reality.
question: Name one part of your business with no feedback loop and add one this week.
closing_statement: No feedback, no way to correct course.
